title: Impresso Image Embedding Request
description: Body of a request to the Impresso Image Embedding endpoint

searchTarget.description: Which embedding space the embedding is going to be used in

model.description: Embedding model to use. Must be compatible with `searchTarget`: `image` supports `dinov2-1024` (default); `multimodal` supports `openclip-768` (default) and `siglip2-768`. When not provided, the default model for the `searchTarget` is used.

bytes.description: Base64-encoded image bytes. JPG and PNG formats are supported.
